page.layout: One text column, full width, numbered list entries running from top to bottom; below the column a catchword at the right and a gathering signature at the centre. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. Show-through from the reverse side in the margins is left out.

main_text.p: 2. Discutientes, ut Aristolochiæ, Asphodeli, Bryoniæ, Capparorum.
3. Abstergentes, Aristolochiæ, Ari, Asparagi, Asphodeli, Bulbi, Chelidonii.
4. Aperientes, ut Allii, Cepæ, Curcumæ, Rhapontici &c.
8. Suppurantes, ut Altheæ, Bryoniæ, Liliorum alborum.
9. Glutinantes, ut Aristolochiæ, Dracunculi, Gentianæ, Sigilli Salomonis, Symphyti.
10. Flatus discutientes, Apii, Acori, Allii, Costi, Dauci, Enulæ, Fœniculi, Galangæ, Petroselini, Peucedani, Zedoariæ, Spicæ Celticæ & Nardi.
11. Semen generantes, ut, Acori, Bulbi, Eryngii, Satyrii, Pastinacæ.
12. Menses moventes; Asari, Ari, Acori, Aristolochiæ, Asphodeli, Allii, Bryoniæ, Centaurii majoris, Cyperi, Costi, Capparorum, Calami aromatici, Dauci, Dictamni, Filipendulæ, Fœniculi,

page.notes: The numbers 10 and 11 are read with some uncertainty from the scan; the signature mark at the foot is read as Q and may be partly worn. Show-through text from the reverse page in the margins was left out. The word "Gra-" is the catchword and is given in bottom_margin, not in the text.
